title: The Minimalist White Villa & Gardens
tagline: Clean minimal aesthetic with an all-white palette, sunken fire pit, and family gardens
description: Designed with a strict aesthetic of restraint, this luxury multi-level villa avoids visual clutter and excess texture, favoring pure architectural volumes bathed in warm architectural lighting. Features include a dedicated kitchen garden, expansive family backyard, sunken fire pit lounge, and cantilevered terrace pergolas.

details.Key Elements: Sunken Fire Pit, Family Lawn, Kitchen Garden, 3D Cutaway Floor Zoning, All-White Minimalist Stucco
